title: Norway Company Registry Change Monitor - BRREG
description: Watch 1-5,000 Norwegian organization numbers in the official BRREG Enhetsregisteret. The first run stores a baseline; every run after that reads BRREG's own update stream and returns only the companies that actually changed.

organizationNumbers.title: Watchlist (organization numbers)
organizationNumbers.description: One Norwegian organization number per entry: exactly 9 digits. Spaces, dots and dashes are removed, and an invoice-style NO...MVA wrapper is stripped, so 923609016, 923 609 016 and NO 923 609 016 MVA are the same company. A repeated number is monitored, charged and compared once.

monitorKey.title: Monitor key
monitorKey.description: Names the stored baseline and update cursor this run compares against. Use one key per watchlist (for example suppliers-no). Changing it starts a fresh baseline. Two runs sharing a key never run at the same time; the second waits or fails rather than corrupting the cursor.

mode.title: What to return
mode.description: changesOnly returns the first-run baseline and, after that, only companies whose official record changed. snapshotAndChanges also returns every unchanged company's current record from stored state, without re-fetching it. Both modes monitor every company, and diagnostics for failed or rejected entries are always returned.

baselineMode.title: First run under a monitor key
baselineMode.description: emitSnapshot returns every company's current record on the first run. storeOnly saves the baseline silently, so the first scheduled alert is a real change rather than a full export.

includeSourcePatch.title: Include BRREG's own change operations
includeSourcePatch.description: Attaches up to 200 official endringer operations as evidence. Classification uses the full patch. Contact and street values are redacted; address objects retain city and municipality code only. The paths remain visible. source_patch_truncated marks a shortened patch.
